maria: Quick follow-up — doing an outreach sweep for last week's incidents. Need owners + rough ETA on remediations, and a check on whether statuspage language + customer summaries need edits. Also noticed a recurring pattern around cache-priming failures. Thoughts?
aj: Assigning remediation owners — can folks confirm? I can own the statuspage draft. Who can take the customer-facing summary and consent for RCA sharing?
sam: I can take the customer summary. ETA EOD Thu. Will coordinate redaction check with Legal.
emily: I'm owning the remediation for cache-priming; root cause looks like TTL mismatch + race in worker init. Plan: patch + staged deploy next week. ETA Tue.
maria: :thumbsup: Emily — can you post the exact rollout gating criteria? We need to update statuspage semantics (investigating vs mitigated).
emily: gating: 95th/50th latency back to baseline for 48h in canary + no error spike. I'll add exact numbers to the rollout doc.
aj: Draft statuspage blurb (pinging for edits): ```We experienced elevated request latency due to cache initialization failures. Mitigation is rolling out; we anticipate normal performance within 48 hours. A full incident summary and RCA will be published when available.```
sam: Short and clear. Suggest replace "anticipate" with "expect"? Also add a link anchor: "More details: <incident-summary-link>"
kate: From Legal: avoid hard promises. Prefer "anticipated" and include a note about customer-requested RCAs requiring consent/redaction.
devon: @ops-bot ran a recurrence check — flagged 3 incidents in last 90 days with the cache-priming pattern. Recommend a separate recurrence review with SRE + Eng-ML.
ops-bot: incident-audit-bot: recurrence pattern detected: cache-priming (3 occurrences) — linked incidents: 1768129012, 1812356789, 1779991110
maria: Ok action items: Emily -> remediation rollout + gating (owner, ETA Tue 1777860000). Sam -> customer summary draft (EOD Thu 1777920000). Aj -> statuspage publish after Sam + Legal signoff. Devon -> schedule recurrence review w/ SRE + eng-ml (by next Wed). I'll update the action tracker and sweep next Monday.
aj: I'll push the statuspage update once Sam posts the summary and Legal gives greenlight.
sam: Uploaded draft: https://drive.redwood/incident-drafts/1777777000 — please review. I'll redact IPs and customer identifiers per Legal checklist.
maria: Thanks all. Small ask: keep replies in this thread so we have a single place for the commit. :eyes:
